---
title: "Transition and transversion patterns: 38 Baculovirus core genes"
format: html
---

This is an independent step-04 analysis of the existing 38-core-gene
concatenated alignment. No alignment, sequence selection, or MAFFT analysis is
performed. The requested `results/alignments/core_38/` alias is checked first;
the current step-02 document actually writes the same alignment to
`results/alignments/core_genes/`, which is used as an explicit fallback.

```{r}
#| label: load-inputs
library(ggplot2)
options(stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
identity_path <- file.path("results", "pairwise_sequence_identity", "core_38_pairwise_identity.tsv")
requested_alignment <- file.path("results", "alignments", "core_38", "concatenated", "core_38.fna")
step02_alignment <- file.path("results", "alignments", "core_genes", "concatenated", "core_38.fna")
alignment_path <- if (file.exists(requested_alignment)) requested_alignment else step02_alignment
partition_path <- file.path(dirname(alignment_path), "partitions.tsv")
output_dir <- file.path("results", "substitution_patterns", "core_38")
figure_dir <- file.path(output_dir, "figures")
dir.create(figure_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
required <- c(alignment_path, identity_path, partition_path)
if (any(!file.exists(required))) stop("Missing required input: ", paste(required[!file.exists(required)], collapse = ", "), call. = FALSE)
read_tsv <- function(path) read.delim(path, sep = "\t", quote = "", na.strings = "", check.names = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
identity_table <- read_tsv(identity_path)
partitions <- read_tsv(partition_path)
required_identity <- c("genome_group_id_1", "genome_group_id_2", "identical_positions", "compared_positions", "identity_percentage", "compared_fraction")
if (length(setdiff(required_identity, names(identity_table))) > 0L) stop("Step-03 identity columns are incomplete.", call. = FALSE)
```

## Alignment and input validation

```{r}
#| label: validate-inputs
read_fasta <- function(path) {
  lines <- readLines(path, warn = FALSE); h <- which(startsWith(lines, ">"))
  if (!length(h) || h[1] != 1L) stop("Invalid FASTA: ", path, call. = FALSE)
  out <- lapply(seq_along(h), function(i) { a <- h[i] + 1L; b <- if (i < length(h)) h[i + 1L] - 1L else length(lines); s <- paste(lines[a:b][nzchar(trimws(lines[a:b]))], collapse = ""); if (!nzchar(s)) stop("Empty FASTA sequence.", call. = FALSE); list(header = substring(lines[h[i]], 2L), sequence = s) })
  ids <- vapply(out, `[[`, character(1), "header"); if (anyDuplicated(ids)) stop("Duplicate FASTA headers.", call. = FALSE); out
}
records <- read_fasta(alignment_path)
genome_ids <- vapply(records, `[[`, character(1), "header"); sequences <- vapply(records, `[[`, character(1), "sequence")
alignment_lengths <- nchar(sequences); number_genomes <- length(genome_ids)
if (anyDuplicated(genome_ids)) stop("Duplicate genome IDs in the alignment.", call. = FALSE)
if (length(unique(alignment_lengths)) != 1L) stop("Alignment sequences have different lengths.", call. = FALSE)
alignment_length <- alignment_lengths[1]; pair_count <- choose(number_genomes, 2L)
if (number_genomes == 520L && pair_count != 134940L) stop("The 520-genome pair count is not 134940.", call. = FALSE)
if (nrow(identity_table) != pair_count) stop("Identity table has the wrong number of pairs.", call. = FALSE)
identity_keys <- paste(identity_table$genome_group_id_1, identity_table$genome_group_id_2, sep = "\r")
if (anyDuplicated(identity_keys) || any(identity_table$genome_group_id_1 == identity_table$genome_group_id_2)) stop("Identity table contains duplicate or self pairs.", call. = FALSE)
if (!all(identity_table$genome_group_id_1 %in% genome_ids) || !all(identity_table$genome_group_id_2 %in% genome_ids)) stop("Identity table contains an unknown genome ID.", call. = FALSE)
if (nrow(partitions) != 38L || any(partitions$end - partitions$start + 1L != partitions$alignment_length) || partitions$end[nrow(partitions)] != alignment_length) stop("Core-gene partitions are invalid.", call. = FALSE)
```

## Pairwise substitution calculations

Each pair is evaluated directly from the alignment. Only paired A/C/G/T
positions are retained. The K2P expression is the same as in the original
step 04 and returns `NA` when either logarithm is undefined.

```{r}
#| label: calculate-and-validate
pairwise_substitutions <- function(sequences, genome_ids) {
  raw <- matrix(unlist(lapply(toupper(sequences), charToRaw), use.names = FALSE), nrow = length(sequences), byrow = TRUE); codes <- as.raw(charToRaw("ACGT")); ind <- lapply(codes, function(x) raw == x); valid <- Reduce(`|`, ind)
  compared_matrix <- tcrossprod(valid * 1L); identical_matrix <- Reduce(`+`, lapply(ind, function(x) tcrossprod(x * 1L)))
  transitions_matrix <- tcrossprod(ind[[1]] * 1L, ind[[3]] * 1L) + tcrossprod(ind[[3]] * 1L, ind[[1]] * 1L) + tcrossprod(ind[[2]] * 1L, ind[[4]] * 1L) + tcrossprod(ind[[4]] * 1L, ind[[2]] * 1L)
  transversions_matrix <- tcrossprod(ind[[1]] * 1L, ind[[2]] * 1L) + tcrossprod(ind[[2]] * 1L, ind[[1]] * 1L) + tcrossprod(ind[[1]] * 1L, ind[[4]] * 1L) + tcrossprod(ind[[4]] * 1L, ind[[1]] * 1L) + tcrossprod(ind[[3]] * 1L, ind[[2]] * 1L) + tcrossprod(ind[[2]] * 1L, ind[[3]] * 1L) + tcrossprod(ind[[3]] * 1L, ind[[4]] * 1L) + tcrossprod(ind[[4]] * 1L, ind[[3]] * 1L)
  ij <- which(upper.tri(compared_matrix), arr.ind = TRUE); compared <- as.integer(compared_matrix[ij]); identical <- as.integer(identical_matrix[ij]); transitions <- as.integer(transitions_matrix[ij]); transversions <- as.integer(transversions_matrix[ij]); P <- ifelse(compared > 0, transitions / compared, NA_real_); Q <- ifelse(compared > 0, transversions / compared, NA_real_); k2p <- ifelse(compared > 0 & 1 - 2 * P - Q > 0 & 1 - 2 * Q > 0, -.5 * log(1 - 2 * P - Q) - .25 * log(1 - 2 * Q), NA_real_)
  data.frame(genome_group_id_1 = genome_ids[ij[,1]], genome_group_id_2 = genome_ids[ij[,2]], compared_positions = compared, identical_positions = identical, transitions = transitions, transversions = transversions, transition_frequency = P, transversion_frequency = Q, observed_divergence = P + Q, identity_percentage = ifelse(compared > 0, 100 * identical / compared, NA_real_), ts_tv_ratio = ifelse(transversions > 0, transitions / transversions, NA_real_), k2p_distance = k2p, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
}
substitution_patterns <- pairwise_substitutions(sequences, genome_ids)
new_keys <- paste(substitution_patterns$genome_group_id_1, substitution_patterns$genome_group_id_2, sep = "\r")
if (!identical(new_keys, identity_keys)) stop("Pair order differs from step 03.", call. = FALSE)
if (any(substitution_patterns$identical_positions + substitution_patterns$transitions + substitution_patterns$transversions != substitution_patterns$compared_positions)) stop("Counts do not sum to compared positions.", call. = FALSE)
if (any(abs(substitution_patterns$identity_percentage - identity_table$identity_percentage) > 1e-10, na.rm = TRUE)) stop("Identity values disagree with step 03.", call. = FALSE)
if (any(abs(substitution_patterns$observed_divergence - (1 - substitution_patterns$identity_percentage / 100)) > 1e-12, na.rm = TRUE)) stop("Observed divergence is inconsistent with identity.", call. = FALSE)
if (any(substitution_patterns$transition_frequency < 0 | substitution_patterns$transition_frequency > 1 | substitution_patterns$transversion_frequency < 0 | substitution_patterns$transversion_frequency > 1, na.rm = TRUE)) stop("Invalid frequencies.", call. = FALSE)
write.table(substitution_patterns, file.path(output_dir, "pairwise_substitution_patterns.tsv"), sep = "\t", quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE, na = "")
```

## Figures

```{r}
#| label: create-pattern-figures
font <- 14; w <- 25.17; h <- 10.5; dpi <- 300; theme_plot <- theme_classic(base_family = "Arial") + theme(axis.text = element_text(size = font), axis.title = element_text(size = font), legend.position = "top", panel.grid = element_blank())
long <- rbind(data.frame(identity_percentage = substitution_patterns$identity_percentage, frequency = substitution_patterns$transition_frequency, type = "Transitions"), data.frame(identity_percentage = substitution_patterns$identity_percentage, frequency = substitution_patterns$transversion_frequency, type = "Transversions")); xlow <- floor(min(long$identity_percentage, na.rm = TRUE) / 10) * 10
p <- ggplot(long, aes(identity_percentage, frequency, colour = type)) + geom_point(alpha = .12, size = .7) + scale_colour_manual(values = c(Transitions = "#0000FF", Transversions = "#FF0000")) + scale_x_continuous(limits = c(xlow, 100), breaks = seq(xlow, 100, 10), expand = c(0,0)) + scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0,.4), breaks = seq(0,.4,.1), labels = scales::label_percent(accuracy = 1), expand = c(0,0)) + labs(x = "Pairwise nucleotide sequence identity (%)", y = "Observed nucleotide differences (%)", colour = NULL) + theme_plot
ggsave(file.path(figure_dir, "transitions_transversions.png"), p, width = 15, height = 15, units = "cm", dpi = dpi, bg = "white"); ggsave(file.path(figure_dir, "transitions_transversions_zoom.png"), p + coord_cartesian(xlim = c(80,100), ylim = c(0,.15)) + theme(legend.position = "none"), width = 15, height = 15, units = "cm", dpi = dpi, bg = "white")
bins <- cut(substitution_patterns$identity_percentage, seq(0,101,1), include.lowest = TRUE, right = TRUE); rs <- do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_along(levels(bins)), function(i) { v <- substitution_patterns$ts_tv_ratio[bins == levels(bins)[i] & is.finite(substitution_patterns$ts_tv_ratio)]; data.frame(identity_bin = levels(bins)[i], identity_midpoint = i-.5, number_of_pairs = length(v), median_ts_tv = if(length(v)) median(v) else NA_real_, lower_quartile = if(length(v)) quantile(v,.25)[[1]] else NA_real_, upper_quartile = if(length(v)) quantile(v,.75)[[1]] else NA_real_, included = length(v) >= 100L) })); write.table(rs, file.path(output_dir, "ts_tv_ratio_by_identity_bin.tsv"), sep = "\t", quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE, na = ""); rs <- rs[rs$included, , drop = FALSE]
r <- ggplot(substitution_patterns[is.finite(substitution_patterns$ts_tv_ratio),], aes(identity_percentage, ts_tv_ratio)) + geom_point(alpha = .12, colour = "#0072B2", size = .7) + geom_ribbon(data = rs, aes(identity_midpoint, ymin = lower_quartile, ymax = upper_quartile), inherit.aes = FALSE, alpha = .25, fill = "#D55E00") + geom_line(data = rs, aes(identity_midpoint, median_ts_tv), inherit.aes = FALSE, colour = "#D55E00") + scale_x_continuous(limits = c(1,100), expand = c(0,.01)) + scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0,NA), expand = expansion(mult = c(0,.05))) + labs(x = "Pairwise nucleotide sequence identity (%)", y = "Transition/transversion ratio (Ts/Tv)") + theme_plot + theme(legend.position = "none"); ggsave(file.path(figure_dir, "transition_transversion_ratio.png"), r, width = w, height = h, units = "cm", dpi = dpi, bg = "white"); ggsave(file.path(figure_dir, "transition_transversion_ratio_zoom.png"), r + coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0,10)), width = w, height = h, units = "cm", dpi = dpi, bg = "white")
k <- ggplot(substitution_patterns[is.finite(substitution_patterns$k2p_distance),], aes(observed_divergence, k2p_distance)) + geom_point(alpha = .12, colour = "#009E73", size = .7) + geom_abline(intercept = 0, slope = 1) + scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0,NA)) + scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0,NA)) + labs(x = "Observed nucleotide divergence", y = "K2P distance (substitutions/site)") + theme_plot + theme(legend.position = "none"); ggsave(file.path(figure_dir, "observed_divergence_vs_k2p.png"), k, width = w, height = h, units = "cm", dpi = dpi, bg = "white")
```

```{r}
#| label: create-k2p-figures
ids <- unique(c(identity_table$genome_group_id_1, identity_table$genome_group_id_2)); n <- length(ids); m <- matrix(NA_real_, n, n, dimnames = list(ids,ids)); a <- match(identity_table$genome_group_id_1,ids); b <- match(identity_table$genome_group_id_2,ids); m[cbind(a,b)] <- identity_table$identity_percentage; m[cbind(b,a)] <- identity_table$identity_percentage; diag(m) <- 100; if(anyNA(m) || !isTRUE(all.equal(m,t(m)))) stop("Identity heatmap matrix invalid.", call. = FALSE); order <- hclust(as.dist(100-m), method="complete")$order
km <- matrix(NA_real_,n,n,dimnames=list(ids,ids)); a <- match(substitution_patterns$genome_group_id_1,ids); b <- match(substitution_patterns$genome_group_id_2,ids); km[cbind(a,b)] <- substitution_patterns$k2p_distance; km[cbind(b,a)] <- substitution_patterns$k2p_distance; diag(km) <- 0; km <- km[order,order]; if(!isTRUE(all.equal(km,t(km)))) stop("K2P heatmap matrix invalid.", call. = FALSE); d <- expand.grid(row=seq_len(n),column=seq_len(n)); d$value <- c(km); lim <- range(substitution_patterns$k2p_distance,na.rm=TRUE)
hm <- ggplot(d,aes(column,row,fill=value))+geom_raster()+scale_fill_gradientn(colours=rev(c("#2166AC","#67A9CF","#D1E5F0","#F7F7F7","#A6DBA0","#009E73")),limits=lim,na.value="#D9D9D9",name="K2P distance\n(substitutions/site)")+scale_x_continuous(expand=c(0,0),breaks=NULL)+scale_y_reverse(expand=c(0,0),breaks=NULL)+coord_fixed()+theme_classic(base_family="Arial")+theme(axis.line=element_blank(),axis.ticks=element_blank(),axis.text=element_blank(),legend.title=element_text(size=12),legend.text=element_text(size=10)); ggsave(file.path(figure_dir,"core_38_pairwise_k2p_heatmap.png"),hm,width=20,height=20,units="cm",dpi=600,bg="white")
v <- substitution_patterns$k2p_distance[is.finite(substitution_patterns$k2p_distance)]; bw <- .01; maxv <- max(v); br <- seq(0,ceiling(maxv/bw)*bw,by=bw); counts <- hist(v,breaks=br,right=TRUE,include.lowest=TRUE,plot=FALSE)$counts; if(sum(counts)!=length(v)) stop("K2P histogram counts invalid.",call.=FALSE); hp <- ggplot(data.frame(k2p_distance=v),aes(k2p_distance))+geom_histogram(binwidth=bw,boundary=0,closed="right",fill="grey70",colour="black")+scale_x_continuous(limits=c(0,maxv),expand=c(0,0))+scale_y_continuous(limits=c(0,max(counts)),expand=expansion(mult=c(0,.05)))+labs(x="K2P distance (substitutions/site)",y="Frequency")+theme_classic(base_family="Arial")+theme(axis.text=element_text(size=14),axis.title=element_text(size=14)); ggsave(file.path(figure_dir,"core_38_pairwise_k2p_histogram_grey.png"),hp,width=25.17,height=10.5,units="cm",dpi=300,bg="white"); hc <- hp+geom_histogram(aes(fill=after_stat((xmin+xmax)/2)),binwidth=bw,boundary=0,closed="right",colour="black")+scale_fill_gradientn(colours=rev(c("#2166AC","#67A9CF","#D1E5F0","#F7F7F7","#A6DBA0","#009E73")),limits=lim,guide="none"); ggsave(file.path(figure_dir,"core_38_pairwise_k2p_histogram_colored.png"),hc,width=25.17,height=10.5,units="cm",dpi=300,bg="white")
```

## Summary and output validation

```{r}
#| label: final-validation
summary_table <- data.frame(number_of_genomes=number_genomes, number_of_pairwise_comparisons=nrow(substitution_patterns), number_of_valid_k2p_distances=sum(is.finite(substitution_patterns$k2p_distance)), number_of_undefined_k2p_distances=sum(!is.finite(substitution_patterns$k2p_distance)))
write.table(summary_table,file.path(output_dir,"substitution_summary.tsv"),sep="\t",quote=FALSE,row.names=FALSE,na="")
expected <- c("pairwise_substitution_patterns.tsv","substitution_summary.tsv","ts_tv_ratio_by_identity_bin.tsv"); figures <- c("transitions_transversions.png","transitions_transversions_zoom.png","transition_transversion_ratio.png","transition_transversion_ratio_zoom.png","observed_divergence_vs_k2p.png","core_38_pairwise_k2p_heatmap.png","core_38_pairwise_k2p_histogram_colored.png","core_38_pairwise_k2p_histogram_grey.png")
if(!all(file.exists(file.path(output_dir,expected))) || !all(file.exists(file.path(figure_dir,figures)))) stop("One or more output files are missing.",call.=FALSE); if(any(file.info(file.path(output_dir,expected))$size<=0) || any(file.info(file.path(figure_dir,figures))$size<=0)) stop("One or more output files are empty.",call.=FALSE); summary_table
```

The old step-04 output remains untouched. `05_species_demarcation.qmd`
still reads `results/substitution_patterns/pairwise_substitution_patterns.tsv`;
adapting that workflow to either dataset requires an explicit path choice and
is intentionally not performed here.
